identity.name: Adwoa Boama Acheampong
identity.title: Analyst & Executive Support
identity.summary: Analyst who turns operational problems into structured requirements, workflows, data and decision tools. Building deeper foundations in Python, machine learning and optimisation.

storyQuote: The best systems are not the most complex — they are the ones that makes things easy. Everything I build starts from that conviction.

experience.summary: Co-building a Ghanaian nonprofit connecting education, culture, commerce and community.
highlights: Translate the shared vision into organizational architecture, requirements and implementation plans.
Develop brand systems, digital products and operating models; coordinate research, design and technical work through action, dependency and risk tracking.
Research accountable digital-trade infrastructure for Africa's informal economy and apply that research to commerce, traceability and food-system prototypes.
Established a shared organisational and product framework, with a live parent website and commerce and analytics prototypes. Wider operational rollout and commercial validation remain in progress.

experience.summary: Advised the Founder and CEO on digital integration and AI-enabled workflows across daily operations and administration.
highlights: Translated operational requirements into system specifications for AGL ERP software.
Deployed agl.software to replace disconnected paper and WhatsApp processes across sales, workshop operations, HR and administration.
Trained employees in data capture, formal reporting, teamwork and workplace ethics; coordinated digitalization requirements with the implementation team.
Deployed production ready ERP in under 32 weeks; formalised employment documentation across all operational roles.
Implemented an eight-week commercial campaign increasing average daily revenue from GHS 1,200 to GHS 2,700 (125%) in 2024.

experience.summary: Conducted operational gap analysis across three branches and redesigned sales and reporting SOPs.
highlights: Coordinated approximately 20 employees, shifts and seven-day branch operations while supporting the Founder and CEO's executive functions.
Managed internal and external compliance and stakeholder affairs.

Contributed to a 120% revenue increase following revised sales procedures; secured a 60% profit share for the business in a structured enterprise agreement and established clearer branch-wide operating and reporting practices.

testimonials.quote: A remarkable professional with an extraordinary ability to transform complex operational challenges into streamlined, efficient systems. Her strategic thinking and execution are of the highest calibre.
